scoreScope: each published W1-W4 report; C1 is an embedded W1 admission check
allowedScoring: Only listed discrete scores. Lower score applies if two anchors fit. If no positive anchor is fully satisfied, assign zero and record the unmet conditions. Every deduction needs evidence references. No unlisted interpolation.

wordCount: Unicode Han codepoints U+3400-U+4DBF or U+4E00-U+9FFF in visible report body; remove Markdown heading lines, fenced code blocks and URLs before counting; no normalization

review.disagreement: retain both scorecards and evidence; PM adjudicates before gate; no averaged automatic pass

selection.A: all assigned A samples terminal with known outcomes; W1 and W2 both pass; rank eligible by mean report score, then complete-success fraction, then same-sample wall time, then actual known cost; freeze at most two once
selection.B: selected finalists must each pass W3 and W4; rank by four-report mean, quality gap>=5 wins; if gap<5 use complete-success fraction, then same-sample wall time, then actual known cost
selection.noPassingCandidates: no default model; do not relax gates
selection.smallSample: no statistical ranking or p95 claims
